name: workspace-model-advisor
description: Local-first workspace token calculator, model recommender, and coding-agent optimizer.

scripts.package:vscode:preflight: node scripts/check-no-telemetry.mjs && pnpm --dir apps/vscode-extension typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/vscode-extension test
scripts.ci: node scripts/check-no-telemetry.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm scan:fixtures && pnpm package:vscode && pnpm package:vscode:inspect && pnpm smoke:cli
scripts.publish:open-vsx:dry-run: node scripts/check-extension-metadata.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm package:vscode && pnpm package:vscode:inspect && echo "Dry run OK. To publish, run 'pnpm publish:open-vsx:local' with the OPEN_VSX_TOKEN env var set."
